text_diff: -Zero uses Context.dev for web scraping, live agent search, and brand data across its AI CRM. Its platform keeps data on 20M+ companies fresh, and switching providers took probably less than five minutes with Codex.
-Upstash's Context7 serves up-to-date docs to AI coding agents. Context.dev powers the website crawling behind it at millions of requests a day, and Claude set up the integration in minutes.
-How Mintlify used Context.dev to power a tool that transforms any GitHub repo URL into a complete, branded documentation site, and got there in under 10 minutes of integration time.
